page.layout: One printed page, photographed at an angle. Running head at top centre "LIBER I." with page number "301" at top right. Below: chapter heading "CAPVT VIII." then a title in italic, then body text in one column, ending with signature "Ii 3" at foot.

main_text.l: CAPVT VIII.

l.i: De Distinctione orbis terrarum respectu coeli.

main_text.l: FVit hucusque dimenfio & diftinctio orbis
terrarum Abfoluta,fequitur diftinctio com-
parata, qua nempe orbis terrarum partes certo
aliquo refpectu inter fe discriminantur.
Diftinctio orbis terrarum comparata eft vel
refpectu coeli, vel refpectu certorum circulorum
in ipfo globo terreftri: vel denique resp. ipfarum
terrae partium inter fefe.
Refpectu Coeli diftinctio terrae iterum eft vel
refpectu plagarum coeli; vel refpectu pofitus fphae-
rae; vel denique refpectu vmbrarum Solis.
Refpectu plagarum coeli orbis ter. pars eft vel
Cardinalis vel Intermedia.
Cardinalis mundi pars eft, quae directe fpectat
vel ortum vel occafum, vel feptentrionem vel
meridiem.
Itaque Cardinalis terrae plaga feu pars eft qua-
druplex: Orientalis verfus eam coeli partem qua
Sol directe oritur; vel Occid. verfus eam coeli par-
tem qua Sol directe occidit: vel Septentrionalis,
quae eft directe verfus polum arcticum: vel de-
niq; Meridionalis, quae eft directe verfus polum
Antarcticum.
De his cardinalibus orbis terrarum plagis sunt
haec theoremata:
I. Etfi vnus idemque locus in terra refpectu
alterius loci fit modo orientalis, modo occide-
ntalis:

page.notes: Running head and page number are at the top of the page. Catchword absent. Text on the right side of the scan is cut off at the left edge of the printed column; words such as "Vit", "Diftinctio", "plagis" and "alterius" are partially truncated by the photograph crop and are reconstructed from context where letters are missing. Some words in the first lines (e.g. "fphaerae") are doubtful. The title is set in italic and is a heading below the chapter number.
